pairs: Verbum quod factum est ad Jeremiam a Domino,
The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord,
quando misit ad eum rex Sedecias Phassur filium Melchiæ,
when king Zedekiah sent Pashhur, the son of Malchiah, and Zephaniah,
the son of Maaseiah, the priest, to him,
si forte faciat Dominus nobiscum secundum omnia mirabilia sua,
Perhaps it may be that the Lord will act toward us according to all his wonders,
and he may withdraw from us.”
“This is what you shall say to Zedekiah:
Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel:
Ecce ego convertam vasa belli quæ in manibus vestris sunt,
Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands,
et quibus vos pugnatis adversum regem Babylonis et Chaldæos qui obsident vos in circuitu murorum:
with which you fight against the king of Babylon and the Chaldeans, who besiege you at the surrounding walls.
et congregabo ea in medio civitatis hujus.
And I will gather these things together in the midst of this city.
Et debellabo ego vos in manu extenta,
And I myself will make war against you:
and in fury, and in indignation,
And I will strike the inhabitants of this city;
homines et bestiæ pestilentia magna morientur.
men and beasts will die from a great pestilence.
et qui derelicti sunt in civitate hac a peste,
and those who have been left behind in this city after pestilence and the sword and famine,
and into the hand of their enemies,
et in manu quærentium animam eorum:
and into the hand of those who seek their lives.
et percutiet eos in ore gladii,
And he will strike them with the edge of the sword.
and he will not be lenient,
and he will not take pity.
And to this people, you shall say:
Ecce ego do coram vobis viam vitæ, et viam mortis.
Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.
Qui habitaverit in urbe hac morietur gladio,
Whoever lives in this city will die by the sword,
But whoever will have departed and fled away to the Chaldeans,
et transfugerit ad Chaldæos qui obsident vos,
et erit ei anima sua quasi spolium.
and his life will be to him like a spoil.
Posui enim faciem meam super civitatem hanc in malum,
For I have set my face against this city for evil,
It will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon,
and he will burn it with fire.
And to the house of the king of Judah,
you shall say: Listen to the word of the Lord,
Hæc dicit Dominus: Judicate mane judicium,
Thus says the Lord: Judge with judgment from early morning,
et eruite vi oppressum de manu calumniantis,
and rescue anyone who is oppressed by violence from the hand of a false accuser.
ne forte egrediatur ut ignis indignatio mea,
Otherwise, my indignation may go forth like a fire,
et non sit qui extinguat, propter malitiam studiorum vestrorum.
and there will be no one who can extinguish it, because of the evil of your intentions.
O inhabitants of a valley with firm and level ground,
And who can enter into our houses?’
Et visitabo super vos juxta fructum studiorum vestrorum,
But I will visit against you according to the fruit of your intentions,
et succendam ignem in saltu ejus,
And I will kindle a fire in its forest.
et devorabit omnia in circuitu ejus.
And it shall devour everything around it.”
